faq.a: Maven is more common in enterprise Spring teams. The wrapper ensures consistent builds.

faq.q: Does it include Spring Security / OAuth2?
faq.a: No — the template is a clean REST API base. Add `spring-boot-starter-security` after generation.

faq.q: What about Spring Data JPA / Hibernate?
faq.a: The template includes the dependencies. Entity/repository examples are in src/main/java.

faq.q: Can I use this with GraalVM native images?
faq.a: Spring Boot 3 supports GraalVM. Add the native profile and build with `./mvnw -Pnative native:compile`.
